senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be white, cmp. Arab. ḥafaš decorticare, cmp. חֲפַר II,] to be free (cmp. חוֹר II). V. next w.

units: Pesik. R. s. 8 (ref. to אֲחַפֵּשׂ, Zeph. I, 12) לא תהא קורא סמי״ך אלא שי״ן אֲחַפֵּשׁ וכ׳ read not the word with Samme but with Shin, ‘I shall deliver &c.’; Yalk. Zeph. 567.
<cite ref="Keritot 11a:69">Kerith. 11ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:20">Lev. XIX, 20</cite>) <he>מכלל דהוא ח׳</he> this implies that he (her betrothed) has been liberated, is a freedman.
